QI1.1.note: PCA of the centred features (QD6) fitted on each QK training sample (QH4), first d components standardised on the sample and applied to the 2,000 test candidates (QH5); explained_variance = [mean, std] over the seeds of the cumulative fraction of the first d; subspace overlap = ||U_a^T U_b||_F^2 / d averaged over the seed pairs; test_component_std_range = [min, max] over seeds and components of the std of the standardised test components; transform computed on the fly

QI1.2.note: angle = c * x of the standardised PCA components (QI1.1, fitted on each QK sample); abs_angle_test = |c x| on the 2,000 test candidates (all seeds and components); aliased_fraction = share of the training-test pairs x components with |c dx| > pi (R_Y of QK-A: cos^2(c dx / 2) no longer decreasing) or > pi / 2 (phase R_Z(2 c x) of QK-Z: cos^2(c dx)), mean over the seeds

QI2.1.note: circuit parameters = angles theta = c x (QI1.2), one circuit for every c; R_Y(theta_i) per qubit, no entanglement; closed form prod cos^2(dtheta_i / 2) against the fidelity of the Qiskit Statevector of the bound circuits on random training-test pairs; kernel values of the same pairs

QI2.2.note: circuit parameters = angles theta = c x (QI1.2); QK-Z = reps x [H, R_Z(2 theta_i), R_ZZ(2 theta_i theta_{i+1}) on the linear chain]; QK-Z-qiskit = pair (pi - theta_i)(pi - theta_{i+1}); fidelities of the Qiskit statevectors against zz_feature_map (linear entanglement, same pair function) on the first reference pairs; kernel values on random training-test pairs; pair-term angle = |2 theta_i theta_{i+1}| on the test candidates (d = 20)

QI2.3.note: QK-Z state (product pair function); expectations <X>, <Y>, <Z> per qubit from the reduced density matrices against Qiskit Statevector.expectation_value; median_gamma = 1 / median squared distance of the expectation vectors of the training states of the pairs (indicative: in QI4 it is computed on the whole training sample); kernels of the same random training-test pairs, projected at s = 1

QI3.1.dtype: Aer states in complex128, products in complex128 (complex64 only for the precision check), kernels in float64
QI3.1.note: states from Qiskit AerSimulator (statevector method, batches of 256 bound circuits, on the CPUs), products on the GPU; overlaps |<Aer|Qiskit Statevector>| and |<Aer|PyTorch QK-Z simulator>| (1 = equal up to a global phase); complex64 vs complex128 products on the first 200 x 200 entries of K_train and K_test (same Aer states); time = training states once + K_train + K_test in chunks

assumptions.qi31_check: QK-Z and QK-Z-qiskit, 2,000 training + 2,000 test states, every d and r
assumptions.qi43_grid: QK-Z states (QK-P reuses them), 5 c x 5 seeds x (500 + 2000) states, every d and r
assumptions.qi43_grid_cv_refit: as qi43_grid + 5 folds x 500 states (PCA refitted in each fold, QI4.2)

QI3.1-qiskit.note: time per state = wall clock / states, one process; Aer: one run on a batch of transpiled circuits bound to the angles (save_statevector), the transpilation (once per d, r) excluded; kernel products, SVM fits and the learning curve excluded; the PyTorch path (QI3.1) computes a full 2,000 x 2,000 configuration in <= 5.3 s on one H100

QI3.2.note: K = fidelity_kernels of QI3.1 (Aer states + matrix products; QK-A closed form) for random training-test pairs; P(0...0) of the compute-uncompute circuit U(x) U(x')^+ simulated by AerSimulator, exact (statevector) and with N shots (all qubits measured, seed fixed); sigma = sqrt(K (1 - K) / N); within = |estimate - K| <= 4 sigma + 1/N; QK-P is not a fidelity kernel and is checked in QI2.3/QI3.1

QI3.3.note: exact kernels of QI3.1 (Aer states); fidelity maps: Binomial(N, K) / N per training pair (once, mirrored, diagonal 1) and per test-training pair; QK-P: every <X>, <Y>, <Z> from N shots, Gaussian kernel with s = 1 x median gamma of the noisy training expectations; training matrix projected on the PSD cone (negative eigenvalues set to 0); rel. Frobenius error = ||K_hat - K|| / ||K||; share_train_values_zero = off-diagonal training values estimated as 0 (before the projection); fixed seeds per configuration

QI4.1.note: smoke run of the QI4.1 classifier with fixed, not tuned, hyper-parameters (tuned results: QI4.2-QI4.3); SVC(kernel='precomputed', class_weight='balanced') in CalibratedClassifierCV(method='sigmoid', ensemble=False, cv=5); proba = Platt P(crater) (score of QI4), margin = decision_function, predict = margin > 0; noisy kernels as QI3.3 (K_train PSD-projected, diagonal 1); AP over the 2,000 test candidates

QI4.2.note: StratifiedGroupKFold (groups = 5 deg blocks, shuffled with the sample seed); PCA of QI1.1 refitted on every training fold; exact kernels; SVC(kernel='precomputed', class_weight='balanced') per fold; criterion = mean fold AP of the margin, ties -> smaller C, r, s, c; cv_f1 = mean fold F1 of predict; best_cv_ap_per_c = best mean fold AP at each c over the other hyper-parameters; test_ap_refit = Platt score of the chosen model refitted on the whole sample (indicative, first seed of QI4.3)

QI4.3.note: mean / std over the seeds (qk_samples.seeds) of the chosen configuration of QI4.2 refitted on the whole sample, Platt AP on the 2,000 test candidates (QH5); [mean, std, runs]; best d = argmax of the mean CV AP over the seeds (ties -> smaller d); per_c = best configuration by CV at each c, refitted (Fig. 3b); every run in results/qi4_runs.csv, CV tables in results/qi4_cv.csv, test scores in <output>/stage2/qi4_test_scores.npz

QI4.4.note: [mean, std] over the seeds of the chosen QI4.3 run at the best d of each map; stage-2 metrics on the 2,000 test candidates of QH5, predicted positive = Platt probability >= default_threshold; per band: positives of the band + all the negatives; e2e_* = estimate on all the labelled Test sub-tiles (stage-1 recall x stage-2 recall, stage-2 precision of the proportional subset); stage1_*_at_e2e_recall = stage 1 alone with its threshold raised to the e2e recall of the run; stage1_alone_qh2.subset_ap = AP of the stage-1 logit on the same 2,000 candidates; 4-8 km band on few positives (see subset)

off-diagonal values of the exact training kernel, [mean, std] over the seeds; var_over_shot = variance / mean K(1-K)/N (< 1: spread below the shot noise of one estimate with N shots); haar_floor = Haar-random states (full concentration); QK-P with the median gamma (s = 1) rescales itself: its concentration is read in projected_expectations (variance of , , across samples, mean Bloch length, variance / (1 -

^2)/N)

QI5.2.note: KTA of the exact training kernel of the 5 main-grid samples, [mean, std] over the seeds; centered = Cortes et al. 2012 (used for the choice), plain = Cristianini et al. 2001; QK-P: s with the largest centred KTA; spearman over the configurations (c, r, s) of a map or of all maps, against the best CV score over C (qi4_cv.csv); kta_choice_vs_cv: configuration with the largest centred KTA against the CV choice of QI4.3 (cv_ap_loss = best mean CV AP - CV AP of the KTA choice); test_ap_at_kta_c: per-c run of QI4.3 at the c chosen by the KTA (other hyper-parameters by CV at that c); every value in results/qi5_alignment.csv; identity_kernel_kta = KTA of the fully concentrated kernel K = I on n balanced samples (the limit of a concentrated fidelity kernel)

QI5.3.note: g(K_C || K_Q) of Huang et al. 2021, kernels normalised to trace N, [mean, std] over the seeds; K_Q = the CV choice of QI4.3 per map, d, seed; K_C = RBF on the same standardised PCA components with gamma = s x median gamma (per gamma: mean over the seeds; min over gamma per seed), and QK-A at the same c for QK-Z / QK-P; g ~ 1: the classical kernel matches the quantum one on any labelling; upper scale ~ sqrt_n; check: g(K || K) at lambda 1e-9

QI5.4.note: training kernels normalised to trace N, [mean, std] over the seeds; participation_ratio from 1 (one eigenvalue: nearly constant kernel) to N (flat: identity, memorisation); n_eig_90 / 99 = largest eigenvalues covering 90 / 99 % of the trace; top_share_mean = share of the trace of the 20 largest; cv_choice = QI4.3 choice; rbf_closest = RBF with the smallest g of QI5.3 at rbf_lambda; c<..> = QK-A / QK-Z (r = 1) at the extreme bandwidths, d = extreme_d; *_centred = the same on H K H (constant part removed, as the centred KTA of QI5.2: the SVM with a bias is blind to it)

QI6.1.note: per representation (each with its own stage 1, QK samples and 2,000 test candidates) and map: the chosen configuration of the spatial CV (QI4.2) on its own sample at the best d of QI4.3, refitted, [mean, std] over the seeds; F-X = the QI4.3 runs; metrics as QI4.4 (Platt probability >= default_threshold; e2e = stage-1 recall x stage-2 recall, stage-2 precision; stage 1 alone at the e2e recall); runs in results/qi6_runs.csv, test scores in <output>/stage2/qi6_<variant>_test_scores.npz

QI7.1.note: [mean, std] over the seeds; test = the true craters among the 2,000 fixed test candidates (QH5); kernel = that of the chosen QSVC of QI4.3 (QK maps) or of the chosen QJ1 RBF (RBF) of the same unit, restricted to the positives; C, epsilon per target by the spatial CV of QI4.2 on the training positives (mean fold MAE of the standardised target); trivial = cell centre and median training radius; centre error with the east-west cell size x cos(lat); R^2 against the test mean (0 = no better than the mean, < 0 worse); runs in results/qi7_runs.csv
